title: Sean McVay: Flight was great, guys seem fresh, we'll be ready to rock

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Sean McVay: Flight was great, guys seem fresh, we'll be ready to rock
sources.description: The Rams' flight to Melbourne landed on Thursday morning local time, which left them with about 28 hours to acclimate to Australia before their game against the 49ers gets underway.
